description:
AI headshots and profile pictures made from your own selfies. Upload 1-8 selfies and get natural photos of yourself in under a minute — a professional LinkedIn headshot, dating profile photos for Hinge or Tinder, an Instagram profile image, or simply a good photo of you. It keeps your real face and features: still you, just the photo you wish someone had taken.

How it works: say what the photo is for, MyBestAngle gives you a private upload link, you add 1-8 clear selfies, press "Make my photos" (or say "done" in the chat) and up to eight photos that pass our identity and realism checks appear in your private gallery. Tell the chat the setting, mood or outfit you want ("outdoor at sunset, navy blazer") and run it again for a new look. Grade each photo ("looks like me" / "not me") — that feedback improves your next run.

Honest limits: results depend on the selfies you upload (clear face, good light, a few angles). The photos are generated images, not camera shots; use them honestly. Adults only, your own selfies only.

defaultPrompt: Make me natural profile photos of myself from my selfies — relaxed and real, not plastic. Give me the upload link.

Make me natural dating profile photos from my selfies — relaxed, approachable, warm evening light. Give me the upload link.
